summary: Phase 1 tested: regime engine units, symbol kill switch API, gate DISABLED + owner reset, trade audit (paper BUY->SELL round trip, /trades/audit, .csv, /buckets), unauthenticated access on new endpoints, and the StrategyHealthCard UI (admin + a fresh DISABLED-gate user). New suite tests/test_iteration12_phase1.py: 21/22 pass. Full regression: 227/229 pass. One real bug: after an auto-kill, the owner re-enable is undone on the next GET /api/strategy/symbols. The iteration5 disconnect test fails only under xdist and passes serially (-n0).

critical.issue: The owner's re-enable of an auto-killed symbol is ignored. symbols() computes stats = rolling(uid) with since=0 and passes them to symbol_state(), which uses them instead of rolling(uid, doc['since']). The old losing trades are still counted, so the very next GET re-disables the symbol with by='auto', writes another symbol_disabled audit event and sends another Telegram alert. The owner can never re-enable a symbol that was auto-killed. Reproduced in TestSymbols::test_reenable_after_auto_kill_stays_enabled (ETH re-killed: PF 0.46 over 25 trades, since=<re-enable ts>).

minor.issue: Ignores the gate's 'since'. After an owner gate reset the card's top-row PF/WIN and per-asset N still show the pre-reset trades (e.g. PF 12.00, N 40), while gate-reason says '0 trades/30d'. This is confusing; consider passing the gate since, or labelling the numbers as 30d raw.

ui_bugs.issue: t.price.toLocaleString crashes the whole dashboard (no error boundary) if any bot_trades row lacks price. Seen with synthetic trades only, but a single bad row blanks the app. Use Number(t.price || 0) and/or add an ErrorBoundary.

action_items: Fix gates.symbols(): don't pass the shared since=0 stats to symbol_state for symbols with doc.since>0 (e.g. call rolling(uid, doc['since']) per symbol when since>0), so an owner re-enable restarts the stats window. Then rerun tests/test_iteration12_phase1.py::TestSymbols::test_reenable_after_auto_kill_stays_enabled
Optional: make /strategy/stats (or the card) respect the gate reset 'since' so the numbers match the gate reason
Optional: guard t.price/l.price in RecentTrades/ExecutionLog and add a React ErrorBoundary
critical_code_review_comments: gates.symbol_state: the stats param bypasses the per-symbol since (root cause of the HIGH bug above)

audit.close_trade: notional_out = gross + entry*qty only approximates the exit notional when there were partial sells at different prices. Fees on partial slices are not modelled separately. Acceptable but approximate.
audit.track is only called in tick_bot, so MAE/MFE come from tick sampling (they can be 0/0 for short trades)
strategy.regime: BREAKOUT triggers for both struct HIGH and LOW. evaluate() blocks LOW (BREAKDOWN) correctly, but the audit/bucket regime label for breakdowns will read BREAKOUT.
seed_data_creation: Only temporary TEST users (test_it12_*), all cleaned up. Admin's SOL was toggled ON then back OFF (restored). An audit_log symbol_enabled/symbol_disabled pair now exists for admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests -q (pytest.ini uses xdist; use -n0 for serial). test_iteration5 disconnect test is flaky under xdist only. Synthetic bot_trades must include price/qty or the RecentTrades UI crashes. UI DISABLED-gate user: python tests/it12_setup_ui_disabled_user.py (password TestPass123!).
rca of the issue: Repro: fresh user -> GET /strategy/symbols -> insert 25 ETH SELL trades (12x +0.5, 13x -1.0) -> GET shows ETH disabled by auto -> POST /strategy/symbols/ETH {enabled:true} returns disabled=false, since=now -> GET /strategy/symbols shows ETH disabled by auto again. Cause: gates.symbols() calls rolling(uid) (since=0) once and passes it as stats. symbol_state evaluates `stats or await rolling(uid, since)`, so since is never applied. Fix: per symbol, use rolling(uid, doc['since']) when doc.since>0, or filter the trades by since.
